make lint passes: ruff check and ruff format --check report no findings.

The G-1 ownership manifest validates in the worktree.
Before the fix, the ASSUMED-path test fails because the ASSUMED doc template lacks the review paragraph.
After the fix, both probe tests pass: the JUnit report shows two tests with no failures or errors, and the ASSUMED doc carries the review paragraph from the same constant the decoded writer uses.
The ASSUMED run exits 0 with no account configured, makes no RPC call, and writes Status: ASSUMED with the review paragraph; its only change to the committed probe.json is probed_at.

Across both rounds the diff changes only the status and note lines of the two writers, the module docstring, the one review-note constant, the new tests, and the regenerated fixture and doc. Every other record and doc field is unchanged.
